ato:report:hint: Open the NDMF console for details. Details are folded per entry. / 详细信息请在 NDMF 控制台中展开查看。
ato:error:component-placement: ATO component must be placed on the avatar root (the object with the VRCAvatarDescriptor). Found on: {0}
ato:error:component-placement:descriptio: Move or remove the component so that exactly one ATO component exists, on the avatar root object. / 请确保整个 Avatar 只存在一个 ATO 组件且挂在 Avatar 根物体上。
ato:error:multiple-components: Multiple ATO components found ({0}); the build was aborted.
ato:error:multiple-components:descriptio: Only one ATO component is allowed per avatar (including children). / 一个 Avatar（含子级）只允许挂载一个 ATO 组件。
ui.generateAtlas.tip: When off, textures are only scaled as a whole; UVs are never rewritten. / 关闭后仅整图缩放，绝不重排UV。
ui.whitelist.tip: Any object type. All textures referenced by listed objects skip every optimization. / 不限类型；条目引用到的全部贴图跳过所有优化。
a.npot.tip: NPOT atlases may save space; unsupported formats (e.g. PVRTC) are excluded automatically and compression failures fall back safely. / NPOT 可节省空间；不支持格式自动剔除，压缩失败自动回退。
c.mip.tip: Mipmaps and MipStreaming are one bound switch (VRChat requires streaming when mips are on). / Mipmap 与 MipStreaming 绑定为同一开关（VRChat 要求开启 Mipmap 必须开启 Streaming）。
